key_point: Square Enix destroyed its own world
title: Square Enix destroyed its own world
caption: Square Enix ended the failed original Final Fantasy XIV by dropping a moon on its world, then relaunched it. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #ffxiv #finalfantasy

instagram.caption:
Final Fantasy XIV launched in 2010 and was a disaster. Square Enix apologized and handed it to a new director, Naoki Yoshida.

He ended the old game with an in-game apocalypse: the moon Dalamud fell and Bahamut burned the world.

In 2013 the world was reborn as A Realm Reborn, now one of the most beloved MMOs. Sometimes an ending is a new start.
